content.name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
entries: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast {@spell Scrying|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also cast {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if {@spell Scrying|SRD52} ends. You can't cast {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} in this way again until the next dawn.
